name: Disdimension
desc: A grimoire that conceals untold might. By summoning power from another dimension, it can weaken enemies and turn the tide of battle.

eff.name: Blood-Soaked Hex
eff.desc1: Grants a [Lv. x 4]% chance to inflict 1 stack(s) of Poison/Sleep/Curse on the target.
eff.desc2: Reduces target's stun symbols by [Lv. x 1].

eff.name: Permanent Handwriting
eff.desc1: Lowers target's Negative Effect resistance by [Lv. x 3]%.
eff.desc2: Extends stun duration by [Lv. x 1] second(s) if the target is stunned.

eff.name: Verses of Enmity
eff.desc1: Reduces ATK, DEF, and SPD by [Lv. x 1]% for each of up to 3 negative effects the target has.
